finding: Shared Event validation accepted blank or whitespace-padded instrument identities.

reproduction.before_fix: 4 values (spaces only, leading/trailing space, and leading tab) failed to raise DataError.

change.behavior: All event kinds require instrument to be a nonempty string equal to its own strip() result; otherwise the stable DataError is raised.

data_boundary: Synthetic malformed-identifier cases and existing project fixtures. No market/account/registry or Validation/Test/Holdout payload was read.
status: Whitespace scope-identity defect resolved and source/installed distribution parity verified.
